steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each workstream is placed by its rating and whether the rating matches its issues.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 green status has an open critical issue

findings.title: Green rating with an open critical issue
findings.fix: Change the rating to match the issue

findings.title: Amber rating with no reason
findings.fix: Give the reason for the rating

findings.title: Workstream with no update this week
findings.fix: Ask the owner for an update

outcome.notChecked: Whether the work is done as reported.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] ws-c.md:12  Green rating with an open critical issue.
       Fix: Change the rating to match the issue.
[medium] ws-b.md:19  Amber rating with no reason.
       Fix: Give the reason for the rating.
[low] ws-f.md:26  Workstream with no update this week.
       Fix: Ask the owner for an update.
Not checked: Whether the work is done as reported.
pros: Checks a red or amber rating with no reason, a green rating with an open critical issue, and a workstream with no update.
cons: Not checked: Whether the work is done as reported.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-weekly-status skill on the records for this review.
